Who's walking your dog

Hi — I'm the one your dog will be very happy to see.

I Walk Doggo's started the way most good things do: with one very floppy-eared dog who needed a midday walk and a person who couldn't say no to that face. Now I walk dogs across the neighborhood, rain or shine, at the pace each one actually wants to go.

Every walk ends the same way — a happy, worn-out dog, ready to collapse on the nearest couch. That part's non-negotiable.

  • Painfully punctual, every single walk
  • GPS-tracked routes with a photo update after every walk
  • Small client list — your dog is never a number
The route

Pick your dog's kind of walk

Every service follows the same trail, just at a different pace — from a quick leg-stretch to a full trail adventure.

1
20 minutes · Solo

Quick Sniff

A brisk walk around the block for dogs who mostly need a bathroom break and a little fresh air between your meetings.

2
30–45 minutes · Solo or duo

Neighborhood Walk

Our most popular walk. A proper loop through the neighborhood with time to sniff every mailbox that matters.

3
60+ minutes · Trail

Trail Adventure

For the high-energy ones. Off to the local trails for a real hike, with plenty of water breaks and photo stops.

4
15 minutes · Drop-in

Midday Check-In

Food, water, a little play, and a good scratch behind the ears — perfect for long workdays.
